fieldNotes.siteIdentity: Address 11700 E 47th Ave resolves (ROOFTOP geocode) to a large multi-tenant cross-dock distribution warehouse in Gateway Park, Denver, not a standalone bottling plant. Primo Brands / ReadyRefresh operates here as a distribution/delivery branch (Yelp + Nextdoor confirm ReadyRefresh at this address). Street View shows trailers from Target, UPS, Mesilla Valley, Roadrunner and Pinnacle Express in the shared yard, confirming multi-tenant use. White Primo/ReadyRefresh delivery vans seen on the east side. Audited the eastern building (the one the rooftop geocode lands on) and its east+west truck yards.
fieldNotes.type: Labeled PL (bottling plant) in the roster, but physically a DC/delivery branch. dockDoorCount, dropArea and yard metrics describe the audited building, which is shared with other tenants, so per-Primo figures are a subset.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Chain-link perimeter fence encloses the east truck yard with vehicle-gate openings (Street View, east face). No barrier arm clearly visible; Google StreetView car drove freely into the central shared drive, so gate control appears light/open. Called true on fenced-yard-with-gates basis.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth visible at any yard entrance in satellite or Street View.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gated/fenced yard with no guard booth implies remote/self check-in (kiosk/app), set true.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: 60 is a conservative estimate for the full audited building: continuous dock banks run nearly the full ~300 m length on BOTH the east and west long faces (cross-dock). Many bays empty in the imagery. Could plausibly be 50-80. Per-Primo share is a fraction.
fieldNotes.dropArea: East drive carries marked stalls painted DROP TRAILERS / ONLY TRAILER with parked trailers; STAGING AREA cells also painted. Banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: ~40 across the east drop strip + west drive shoulder; estimate from overhead.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks on two physically separate building faces (east and west), so shipping/receiving can run from distinct dock banks.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Separate east-side drive and west-side (shared) drive give independent in/out paths; lane counts ~1 each, low confidence.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide central shared drive and east drop apron provide ample paved width to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.rail: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense Gateway Park industrial fabric inside metro Denver = Urban; cellular coverage strong, connectivityIssue false.
fieldNotes.geometry: Building is near axis-aligned (very slight rotation off north); rings traced as tight quads to the fence/wall/apron lines. siteAreaAcres ~15.9 from the eastern-building parcel incl. its east and west truck drives.
